description: This file is a PHP class that manages shipping extensions within the Opencart admin interface. It includes methods for listing, installing, and uninstalling shipping extensions, as well as handling permissions and loading related resources.

classes.name: Shipping
classes.description: Controller class managing shipping extensions in the Opencart admin area, facilitating extension listing, installation, and uninstallation.

methods.name: index
methods.description: Default method that outputs the list of available shipping extensions.

methods.name: getList
methods.description: Retrieves and displays a list of available and installed shipping extensions, loading necessary data and resources.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Handles the installation process for a shipping extension, including permission checks and resource registration.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Handles the uninstallation process for a shipping extension, including permission checks and cleanup.
